user.description: Create an API credential in PatchMon under Settings → Integrations → Auto-Enrollment & API, with the host "get" scope.

reauth_confirm.description: PatchMon rejected the API credential. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the PatchMon API at this URL.
error.invalid_auth: PatchMon rejected the credential. Check the key, the secret, its "get" scope, and any IP restriction.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This PatchMon server is already configured.
